title: Rabbi Yose bar Aivu
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Bereshit Rabbah 34:13 mentions him reporting Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman suggests he may be the one named Rav Yosef bar Abba in Berakhot 59b, reporting Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim, however, reads simply Rav Yosef, as also cited by Rashbam on Pesachim 101a.
